captions.detailed: A miniature jeweler's bench vise rendered in dark gray and black plastic or steel. It features a circular base supporting a large spherical ball joint, which allows the main vise body to rotate continuously in all directions. The main vise assembly consists of a fixed rear jaw, a prismatic sliding front jaw, and a hexagonal tightening knob on the front to secure small workpieces.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a jeweler's bench vise with a rotating ball base. The model must include a circular bottom support, a spherical joint, a main vise body with a fixed jaw, a sliding front jaw that moves prismatically, and a hexagonal tightening knob that rotates continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat cylinder and a hollowed-out block to cradle a sphere primitive. Attach a cylindrical neck to the sphere to support the main vise body, which is built from box primitives representing the fixed jaw and guide rails. Model the sliding jaw and the hexagonal tightening knob as separate parts, aligning them along the main axis with prismatic and continuous rotational joints respectively.
